profile.name: Jordan Mitchell
profile.title: Senior Software Engineer
profile.headline: Building scalable, user-centric applications with modern web technologies
profile.introduction: I am a full-stack software engineer with 8+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade applications. I specialize in Angular, .NET, and cloud-native architectures that balance performance, maintainability, and exceptional user experience.
profile.summary: Passionate about clean architecture, mentoring engineering teams, and translating complex business requirements into elegant technical solutions. I thrive in collaborative environments where quality, accessibility, and continuous improvement are core values.
careerHighlights: Led migration of a monolithic ERP system to microservices, reducing deployment time by 70%
Architected a real-time analytics dashboard serving 50K+ daily active users
Mentored 12 junior developers through structured onboarding and code review programs
Reduced application load times by 45% through performance optimization and lazy loading
Established CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices adopted across 4 engineering teams

projects.title: Enterprise Employee Portal
projects.shortDescription: A centralized HR and operations portal for 10,000+ employees.
projects.description: Designed and developed a comprehensive employee self-service portal integrating HR, payroll, and internal communications. The platform features role-based access control, real-time notifications, and seamless integration with legacy systems.
responsibilities: Led frontend architecture and component library design
Implemented real-time notification system using SignalR
Designed RESTful APIs and integration layer for legacy systems
Conducted code reviews and established coding standards
challenges: Migrated 200+ screens from legacy ASP.NET WebForms without downtime
Implemented optimistic UI updates for improved perceived performance
Built accessible components meeting WCAG 2.1 AA standards

projects.title: Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
projects.shortDescription: Interactive BI dashboard with live data streaming and custom reports.
projects.description: Built a high-performance analytics dashboard that processes millions of events daily. Features include customizable widgets, drill-down reports, export capabilities, and role-based data visibility.
responsibilities: Architected modular widget system with lazy-loaded chart components
Optimized query performance reducing report generation from 30s to 2s
Implemented WebSocket-based live data updates
Created automated testing suite with 85% code coverage
challenges: Handled 50K concurrent WebSocket connections with horizontal scaling
Designed efficient data aggregation pipeline for sub-second queries
Built responsive charts that work across desktop and tablet devices

projects.title: B2B E-Commerce Platform
projects.shortDescription: Multi-tenant e-commerce solution for wholesale distributors.
projects.description: Developed a scalable B2B e-commerce platform supporting multiple tenants with custom pricing, bulk ordering, and integrated inventory management. The platform handles $2M+ in monthly transactions.
responsibilities: Designed multi-tenant architecture with data isolation
Built shopping cart and checkout flow with payment integration
Implemented full-text search with Elasticsearch
Set up monitoring and alerting with CloudWatch
challenges: Ensured PCI compliance for payment processing
Implemented complex pricing rules engine for tiered customer discounts
Achieved 99.9% uptime through auto-scaling and health checks
